findings.title: Pricing Bounds Roundtrip Bypass via Double-Rounding in calculateFixedInput
confidence_deductions: -10: Impact limited to creator's price protection (not direct fund theft)
-5: Requires token creator to have set pricing bounds
findings.description: CLOBTransferHandler._enforceTokenHooks computes amountOut via two consecutive mulDivRoundingUp operations (calculateFixedInput). AMMStandardHook.validateHandlerOrder then reconstructs sqrtPriceX96 from (amountOut, amountIn) using computeRatioX96, ignoring the handlerOrderParams which contains the exact sqrtPriceX96. When sqrtPriceX96 is low enough that true amountOut < 1 wei, double rounding inflates amountOut to 1. computeRatioX96(1, orderAmount) returns a price orders of magnitude higher than actual, bypassing minimum pricing bounds.
findings.impact: Token creators set pricing bounds to prevent their token from being sold below a floor price on the CLOB. This bypass allows any maker to open orders at prices far below the minimum, defeating the creator's price protection. When filled, tokens trade below the intended floor.
findings.proof_sketch: calculateFixedInput(1e18, 1e10): step1=ceil(1e28/Q96)=1, step2=ceil(1e10/Q96)=1. computeRatioX96(1,1e18)≈7.92e19. Actual price 1e10, reconstructed 7.92e19 — 7.9 billion x inflation. Min bound of 1e18 is bypassed. See H01_PricingBoundsRoundtripBypass.t.sol for full compiling PoC.
findings.victim: Token creator who set pricing bounds via registryUpdatePricingBounds
findings.extractable_value: Ability to open CLOB orders below floor price; economic loss = difference between floor price and actual fill price × volume
attack_sequence: 1. Token creator sets minSqrtPriceX96 = 1e18 via registryUpdatePricingBounds
3. Attacker opens order at sqrtPriceX96 = 1e10 (far below minimum)
6. Order passes pricing bounds check despite being 1e8x below minimum
7. When filled, attacker/taker purchases token at below-floor price
prerequisites: Token creator must have set pricing bounds on the token
Order amount must be large enough relative to price that amountOut rounds to 1
findings.refutation_attempted: Investigated whether bounds check happens elsewhere (e.g., in openOrder or CLOBHook). The only pricing bounds enforcement for CLOB orders is in _enforceTokenHooks → validateHandlerOrder. The handlerOrderParams containing the exact price is marked /* unused */. No secondary check exists.

hot_spots.reason: Double mulDivRoundingUp produces inflated output for extreme prices, enabling pricing bounds bypass
handlerOrderParams is /* unused */ — exact price is ignored, reconstructed from amounts via lossy roundtrip
No balance check on output transfer (line 2239). If FOT tokens could enter pools, this would create insolvency. Currently mitigated by _collectToken checks.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Reentrancy via _setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) clearing ENTERED bit
ruled_out_vectors.description: _setReentrancyFlags masks out ENTERED/NOT_ENTERED before applying new flags, preserving the ENTERED bit. Re-entry is blocked.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Nested operation fee drops after flag clearing
ruled_out_vectors.description: ENTERED bit preserved by _setReentrancyFlags prevents all nested operations via nonReentrant check.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Hook fee key mismatch in _storeNonTokenHookFees
ruled_out_vectors.description: When tokenFor == tokenFee (the normal case for non-token hooks), storage and retrieval keys match. Mismatch only occurs with incorrect API usage.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Cross-swap transient storage leak
ruled_out_vectors.description: Known FP #1 from audit digest. Slot is overwritten by beforeSwap per-token, second overwrites first intentionally.

ruled_out_vectors.title: afterSwapRefund reentrancy into CLOB
ruled_out_vectors.description: AMM ENTERED bit still set during transfer handler callback. Re-entry into AMM blocked.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Fill-or-kill permits incompatible with fees
ruled_out_vectors.description: Executor sets fees and can set them to 0 for fill-or-kill. Signer protected by limitAmount. Self-inflicted config error per FP pattern #4.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Partial fill hook fee overcharge
ruled_out_vectors.description: Hook fees stored before partial fill adjustment but total distribution equals pool output. No tokens created. User protected by minAmountSpecified.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Whitelist desync permanent stale
ruled_out_vectors.description: Admin config error — whitelist owner controls which hooks to sync. Falls under FP pattern #4.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Order ID slot zero collision in CLOB
ruled_out_vectors.description: Sentinel bucket at type(uint160).max has inputAmountRemaining = 0, causing fill loop to terminate safely before accessing phantom order at slot 0.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Pool creation cross-token bounds gap
ruled_out_vectors.description: AMM calls _executeTokenPoolCreationHook for BOTH tokens during pool creation. Each hook validates independently.

ruled_out_vectors.title: FOT token CLOB insolvency
ruled_out_vectors.description: FOT tokens blocked at ALL entry points: depositToken (line 368), openOrder (line 508), _collectToken (line 2917), swap input (line 2208). Tokens can never enter system.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Stale pricing bounds after registry update
ruled_out_vectors.description: Orders validated at creation time only. Existing orders remain valid after bounds tightened. Standard order book behavior — no retroactive cancellation.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Pricing bounds applied to wrong token pair
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pricing bounds correctly use token→pairedToken lookup per pair. No cross-contamination.

ruled_out_vectors.title: Direct swap pricing bounds bypass via fee
ruled_out_vectors.description: Pricing bounds check uses pool sqrtPrice (pool swaps) or raw swap amounts (direct swaps). Fees applied after hook validation. No bypass possible.

theft_theses.title: Extract value via pricing bounds bypass on CLOB
theft_theses.detail: Maker opens orders below floor price, when filled, purchases token below creator's intended minimum. Medium severity — no direct fund theft but defeats creator's economic protection.

theft_theses.title: Leave protocol with bad debt via FOT token CLOB insolvency
theft_theses.detail: FOT tokens blocked at all 4 entry points (_collectToken, depositToken, openOrder auto-deposit, swap input strict equality). Cannot enter system.

theft_theses.title: Re-enter during fee distribution to double-collect
theft_theses.detail: ENTERED bit (bit 1) preserved by _setReentrancyFlags. ALL nonReentrant functions check ENTERED before allowing entry. Confirmed symbolically by Halmos.

hypothesis_results.detail: _setReentrancyFlags preserves ENTERED bit (bit 1). After clearing custom flags with NO_FLAGS, newState = ENTERED | 0 = ENTERED. Re-entry blocked. Confirmed by Halmos symbolic execution.
Same root cause as CH-14. ENTERED bit preserved, preventing any nested operations from re-entering nonReentrant-protected functions during fee distribution.
Key mismatch only occurs when tokenFor != tokenFee, which doesn't happen for non-token hooks. Storage and retrieval keys match when tokenFee == tokenFor (verified with keccak hash comparison).
Known FP #1 from audit digest. Transient storage slot overwrite is by-design. beforeSwap overwrites stale value. Not exploitable.
AMM ENTERED bit remains set during afterSwapRefund. While CLOB's own reentrancy guard is released, re-entry into AMM functions is blocked by AMM's ENTERED bit.
Fill-or-kill check reverts when fees applied, but executor sets fees. Setting fees to 0 for fill-or-kill is a design constraint, not a vulnerability. Signer protected by limitAmount.
Hook fees stored before partial fill but total distribution equals pool output (verified: adjustedAmount + F = Y). No insolvency. User protected by minAmountSpecified.
Whitelist desync is admin configuration error. No attacker profit — admin controls which hooks to sync. FP pattern #4: self-inflicted config errors.
Sentinel bucket at type(uint160).max has default inputAmountRemaining = 0. Fill loop terminates before accessing phantom order at slot 0.
AMM calls _executeTokenPoolCreationHook for BOTH token0 and token1 independently. Each hook validates its own token's bounds. No gap.

Pricing bounds roundtrip bypass confirmed. calculateFixedInput double-rounds amountOut to 1 for extreme prices. computeRatioX96 reconstructs inflated price (~7.92e19 for actual 1e10). Bypasses minimum pricing bounds. Full PoC compiles and passes.

FOT token CLOB insolvency hypothesis dismissed. FOT tokens blocked at all 4 entry points: depositToken (line 368 strict equality), openOrder auto-deposit (line 508), _collectToken for addLiquidity (line 2917), swap input (line 2208). No path for FOT tokens to enter system.
Stale pricing bounds after registry update: orders validated at creation time only. Standard order book behavior — no retroactive order cancellation. Not a vulnerability.
Pricing bounds use correct token→pairedToken lookup per pair. hookForTokenIn determines which token's bounds to check. No cross-pair contamination.
Direct swap pricing bounds checked via pool sqrtPrice (pool swaps) or computeRatioX96 of raw amounts (direct swaps). Fees applied AFTER hook validation in settlement. No fee-based bypass possible.
